_schema.note: Curated to federal-health-IT-relevant agencies. Each entry includes the official forecast URL plus our read on data accessibility (HTML-only, downloadable, or API).

agencies.mmt_note: VA OSDBU posts a forecast spreadsheet quarterly. Health-IT relevant items concentrate in the OIT portfolio (T4NG2 task orders) and VHA medical IT. Cross-check against contracts.json for Tracker overlap.

agencies.agency: Defense Health Agency (via DoD Acquisition Forecasts)
agencies.format: HTML — links to each Component's forecast
agencies.cadence: Per-component cadence varies; DHA refreshes annually with intra-year addenda
agencies.mmt_note: DHA-specific items live within the broader Defense Health Program forecast. PEO DHMS and DHA J-6 procurement signals show up here before they land on SAM.gov.

agencies.agency: Department of Health and Human Services
agencies.mmt_note: HHS uses mySBCX as the unified small-business forecast portal across CMS, NIH, ARPA-H, CDC, FDA, IHS, ONC. Filter by Operating Division for component-specific signals.

agencies.format: Web app with structured filters and CSV export
agencies.mmt_note: DHS APFS is the gold-standard federal forecast UX. Not health-relevant directly, but worth watching as the format other agencies emulate.
GSA forecast covers Schedules, governmentwide IDIQs (Alliant 3, OASIS+, etc.), and FAS/PBS buys. Health-IT relevant when DHA or VA buys via GSA vehicles.
Each Service medical department (Army MEDCOM, AFMS, BUMED) maintains its own forecast linked from the DoD hub.
